notes: 1024-QAM with the Gray mapping of M44.2 section 1 (unit average power), one sample per symbol, through the symbol-spaced channel 1 + 0.15 e^(j0.9) z^-1 + 0.05 e^(-j1.7) z^-2 (channel: [lag, magnitude, phase]), turned by the carrier phase 0.2 rad, plus complex noise for Eb/N0 30 dB per transmitted symbol energy; equalize with 11 taps, no feedback, the constellation qam1024 (blind with the multi-modulus algorithm of M44.4 section 3, the radius of one axis R = 613 / 682), mu_cma 0.01 for the first 8000 symbols, then decision-directed with mu_dd 0.01, the phase tracker at phase_bw 0.005; exact float32 model over the whole input in one call; weights are the final weights, final_mse_bits, final_mode, final_phase and final_frequency_bits the final state; the generator asserts that every decision of the last quarter is the transmitted symbol delayed by 5 and turned by quarter_turns quarter turns (symbol_errors_last_quarter) and that mse ends below 0.0002; snr_db_guard compares with the float64 loop (D111)
